I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread: the store was Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own message in #central-team on June 9. She said the morning receiver at Pine Crossing could see only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note instead. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce the problem using the store's login. Nobody has posted in that channel since then to say whether it was fixed.

I couldn't find any Marrow Agrisupply account files in the share, so the channel was the only source.
